# **Date:** 22/07/2015 

## **ORDER** 

## **Re: Review of Regulations - Life Insurance** 

> Pursuant to th e amendmen ts carried out in the Insurance Act, 1938 vide THE INSURANCE LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015, it has become necessary to relook the existing regulations, particularly 

> related to actuarial valuation aspects of Life Insurance business and its regulatory reporting requirements. 

Committee consisting of subject matter expert from the industry and the Authority. The Committee Accordingly, in order to review the existing regulations and to draw a frame work fo r the most shall comprise of the following members: appropriate regulatory directives in each of the area of concern, the Authority hereby constitutes a 

|**SINo.**|**NameoftheMember**|**Portfolio**|
|---|---|---|
|1|Mr.S K Pujari|Chairman|
|2|Mr. B N Rangarajan|Member|
|3|Mr. DSaiSrinivas|Member|
|4|Mr.PKArora|Member|
|5|Mr. Sanjeeb Kumar|Member|
|6|Mr.Satyan Jambunathan|Member|
|7|Mr. Vivek Jalan|Member|
|8|Mr.Sudipta Bhattacharya|MemberConvenor|



> Terms of Reference of the Committee shall be to study and review the following Regulations/provisions and recommend suitable regu latory approach/changes so as to adopt such recommendations suitably in the regulatory system : 

1. IRDA (Assets, Liabilities and Solvency Margin) Regulations, 2000. 

2. IRDA (Act uarial Report and Abstract) Regulations, 2000. 

3. IRDA(Life Insurance-Reinsurance), Regulations,2013 

4. Appointed Actuary Re gulations for Life Insurance. 

5. Appointed Actuary's Annual Report. 

6. Any other related matt er that the Committee feels necessary to address in this context. 

> The Committee is authorized to invite any expert on the subject for interaction during the assigned exercise . The wo rkgroup may meet as many times as may be required either in Hyderabad or any other place depending on the requi rement. The Committee shall submit its report within one month to the Member (Actuary) from the date of publication of this order.
